# `bs completion`

- **Usage:** `bs completion [FLAGS] [ACTION]`

Generate completions or install/uninstall shell setup

## Arguments
- **`[ACTION]`** — Omit to print a script; install/uninstall support bash, zsh and fish

  **Choices:** `install`, `uninstall`

## Flags
- **`--shell <SHELL>`** — Shell to configure; install/uninstall default to SHELL

  **Choices:** `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, `elvish`, `nu`, `powershell`
- **`--dry-run`** — Preview install/uninstall without changing files
- **`--yes`** — Approve install/uninstall without prompting
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
